Test Description: Validate PCIe DBI DSP configuration registers for correct reset values and masked write/readback behavior across multiple data patterns. Read-only or non-accessible fields are respected via masks and a skip list. The test passes when all readable registers match their expected reset values and all writable, readable fields read back the expected masked values for each pattern.
Meta Test Description: Source: program.c (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/titusbspgit/PSVValidation/main/TestRepo/pcie/pcie0_dbi_dsp_reg_wr_rd_test/program.c), test_define.c (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/titusbspgit/PSVValidation/main/TestRepo/pcie/pcie0_dbi_dsp_reg_wr_rd_test/test_define.c). The test enumerates CNT=775 DBI DSP register addresses from addr_array[]. Two phases execute: (1) Default value check (chk_rst_val): For each address i, skip if read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000. Additionally skip three registers from default check: mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_CAP_ID_NXT_PTR_REG, mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DEVICE_CONTROL_DEVICE_STATUS, mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_PL_DEBUG1_OFF. Otherwise, read via read_reg(addr) and compare to default_value_array[i]; increment def_fail_cnt on mismatch. (2) Write & Read check (chk_rd_wr): For each of six patterns {0xFFFFFFFF, 0xAAAAAAAA, 0x55555555, 0x00000000, 0xA5A5A5A5, 0xFFFF0000}, write data_wr to all addresses where skip_array[i]==0 and write_mask_array[i]!=0x00000000; use write_reg(addr,data_wr). Then, for readback, iterate all addresses and skip if skip_array[i]==1 or write_mask_array[i]==0x00000000 or read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000. Read data_rd=read_reg(addr). Compute wr_n=(write_mask_array[i]^0xFFFFFFFF) and expected value exp_val=((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])). Compare data_rd vs exp_val; increment wr_fail_cnt on mismatch. The top-level test_case() calls chk_rst_val(), then chk_rd_wr(), and finally calls finish(1) if (def_fail_cnt>0 || wr_fail_cnt>0), else finish(0). A soft_reset_chk() function exists (writes 0x00000000 to SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS, waits, restores value) but is not invoked.
Remarks: Registers with no read access are excluded from reads. Writes are only attempted to fields with write access; readback validation uses mask-based expectations to preserve non-writable bits at their reset values. A predefined skip list excludes specific problematic or side-effect registers from both writes and reads. The following registers are intentionally excluded from the reset-value check: DBI_DSP_CAP_ID_NXT_PTR_REG, DBI_DSP_DEVICE_CONTROL_DEVICE_STATUS, DBI_DSP_PL_DEBUG1_OFF. The soft reset routine is present but not executed in this test.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1. Enumerate the DBI DSP configuration register list provided by the test. 2. For each readable register, verify that its reset value matches the expected default. 3. Exclude the following from default-value verification: DBI_DSP_CAP_ID_NXT_PTR_REG, DBI_DSP_DEVICE_CONTROL_DEVICE_STATUS, DBI_DSP_PL_DEBUG1_OFF. 4. For each of the six data patterns, write the pattern to all registers that allow writes and are not in the skip list. 5. For each written register that is also readable, read back the value. 6. Validate that writable bits reflect the pattern and non-writable bits retain their default values, per the masks. 7. Record any mismatches found during default checks or write/readback checks. 8. Declare the test PASS only if no mismatches are detected across all phases and patterns; otherwise, declare FAIL.

Test Steps / Procedure: 1. Identify a set of PCIe configuration registers for validation. 2. For each selected register, capture its current value for reference. 3. Write predefined data patterns to each writable configuration register. 4. Read back each register after each write. 5. Compare the read-back value to the expected value for the written pattern. 6. Record any mismatches and determine overall pass/fail based on zero mismatches.
Impacted Registers: DBI_DEVICE_CONTROL_DEVICE_STATUS; DBI_LINK_CONTROL_LINK_STATUS; STATUS_COMMAND; TYPE1_DEV_ID_VEND_ID; BAR0_MASK_REG; BAR1_MASK_REG; CAP_ID_NXT_PTR; AER_EXT_CAP_HDR
Validation / Acceptance Criteria: Pass if all read-back values match the expected values for each written pattern across all tested configuration registers; otherwise, fail.
